elements.label: Hero voice orb shrinking into widget avatar

elements.manual_reason: The widget container pill has no candidate box (b01 is the larger diff region of the shrinking orb); it expands rightward out from behind the orb.
elements.label: Call widget container

pattern.description: The full-frame voice orb shrinks and slides left to become the avatar of a compact call widget; the widget pill extends out to the right from behind it, a small outlined circle stretches into the 'End' call button, and the hint 'Talk to interrupt' fades in word by word.
pattern.why_premium: The hero visual literally becomes the product UI, so the viewer understands the orb is the agent they will talk to; the circle-to-pill button morph and staggered hint text make the widget feel alive rather than pasted in.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.orb', {scale: 0.22, x: -130, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.inOut'}); tl.fromTo('.widget', {clipPath: 'inset(0 100% 0 0 round 40px)', autoAlpha: 0}, {clipPath: 'inset(0 0% 0 0 round 40px)', autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power3.out'}, '-=0.1'); tl.fromTo('.end-btn', {width: 36, borderRadius: 18}, {width: 200, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.out'}, '-=0.1'); tl.from('.end-btn .label', {autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.15}, '-=0.05'); tl.from('.hint .word', {autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power1.out', stagger: 0.08}, '<').
build_hint.remotion: Orb: spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 150}}) driving scale 1->0.22 and translateX; widget clip width = interpolate(spring delayed 3 frames, [0,1], [0,100])%; End button width from a spring (damping 200) delayed 6 frames, label opacity after; hint words opacity interpolate with per-word 2-frame delay.

notes: Hint text reads 'Talk to interrupt' but 'Talk' is still near-transparent in the end frame, so OCR box b02 captures only 'to interrupt' (recorded verbatim). Could arguably be layout_reframe; proposed a new name because the orb-to-avatar dock with widget expansion is a distinct, reusable move.
